a.title: Everyday Activities
a.summary: Time and routine, food and drink, the human body and health, travel and transport — connected through useful present, past and future communication.
subtopics: Time expressions: time, days, months, seasons, routine, frequency and sequencing
Food and drink: meals, ingredients, quantities, menus, ordering and healthy choices
The human body and health: body parts, symptoms, treatment, advice and wellbeing
Travel and transport: journeys, tickets, timetables, directions and travel problems
grammar: Present-tense control and daily-routine verb patterns
Clock time, dates, ordinal numbers and number–noun agreement
Frequency adverbs, sequencing expressions and time frames
Imperatives, negative commands and advice structures
Past and future time frames for journeys and experiences
Prepositions, attached pronouns and common weak verbs

skills.Listening: Timetables, café exchanges, health conversations, announcements and travel updates
skills.Reading: Menus, schedules, health advice, signs, notices, tickets and short articles
skills.Speaking: Order food, describe routines and symptoms, seek help and manage travel situations
skills.Writing: Routine descriptions, advice, messages, travel accounts and connected topic responses

lessons.title: Time and Daily Routine
lessons.focus: Describe your daily routine using accurate present-tense verbs, times and connected sentences.
lessons.grammar: Present tense; subject–verb agreement

lessons.title: Calendar, Dates and the School Week
lessons.focus: Communicate clock times, days, dates, months and the organisation of a school week.
lessons.grammar: Ordinal numbers; clock expressions; prepositions of time

lessons.title: Frequency, Sequencing and Communication
lessons.focus: Explain how often things happen, connect events and communicate about your day or week.
lessons.grammar: Adverbs; connectors; before/after; عندما

lessons.title: Food and Drink — Meals and Preferences
lessons.focus: Describe meals, food and drink, express preferences and explain your choices.
lessons.grammar: Idāfa; adjective agreement; plurals

lessons.title: Eating Out — Café, Menu and Prices
lessons.arabic: تَنَاوُلُ الطَّعَامِ خَارِجَ الْبَيْتِ: الْمَقْهَى وَقَائِمَةُ الطَّعَامِ وَالْأَسْعَارُ
lessons.focus: Read a menu, ask about prices and order food politely in a café or restaurant.
lessons.grammar: Requests; imperatives; attached pronouns; numbers

lessons.title: Healthy Eating and Lifestyle Choices
lessons.focus: Discuss nutrition, balanced habits, physical activity, sleep and practical lifestyle advice.
lessons.grammar: Nutrition vocabulary; modal advice; reasons and healthy habits

lessons.title: Body Parts and Health Problems
lessons.focus: Name body parts, describe symptoms and explain how you feel.
lessons.grammar: Possessive suffixes; عند; symptoms and duration

lessons.title: Doctor, Pharmacy and Advice
lessons.focus: Describe a health problem, understand a consultation and give appropriate general advice.
lessons.grammar: Advice with أن; subjunctive; requests and health vocabulary

lessons.title: Travel and Transport for Everyday Journeys
lessons.arabic: السَّفَرُ وَوَسَائِلُ النَّقْلِ فِي الرِّحْلَاتِ الْيَوْمِيَّةِ
lessons.focus: Describe transport, plan everyday journeys, understand timetables and ask for directions.
lessons.grammar: Travel verbs; prepositions; time; comparison; directions

lessons.title: Reading and Listening Exam Skills
lessons.focus: Practise understanding Topic A texts, locating evidence and checking answers against distractors.
lessons.grammar: Question strategies; time frames; evidence and distractors

lessons.title: Reading — Travel and Tourism Texts
lessons.focus: Read travel and tourism texts, identify details and infer meaning using contextual evidence.
lessons.grammar: Reading inference; vocabulary in context; time frames

lessons.title: Topic A Review and Assessment
lessons.focus: Retrieve the complete Topic A language, practise all four skills and identify your next revision target.
lessons.grammar: Cumulative Topic A grammar and four-skills review

practice.title: Routine sequencing race
practice.text: Reorder mixed-up routine cards, add realistic times, then retell the day with accurate present-tense verbs and sequencing expressions.

practice.title: Calendar and time bingo
practice.text: Listen for days, dates, months and clock times, mark the matching square, then create two clues of your own using complete Arabic time expressions.

practice.title: Frequency ladder
practice.text: Rank activities from never to always, justify two choices and combine them with before, after and when to build a connected mini-routine.

practice.title: Food preference survey
practice.text: Interview a partner about meals, food and drink. Record preferences and reasons, then report the results with accurate adjective and noun agreement.

practice.title: Menu budget challenge
practice.text: Choose a complete meal within a fixed budget, ask about prices and quantities, then role-play a polite order including one change or special request.

practice.title: Healthy-choice sort
practice.text: Sort habits into helpful, unhelpful or depends. Give a reason for each decision and turn three statements into practical health advice.

practice.title: Symptom detective
practice.text: Describe a health problem without naming it. Partners identify the symptom, body part and likely duration, then ask one sensible follow-up question.

practice.title: Doctor and pharmacy role-play
practice.text: Take turns as patient and health professional: explain symptoms, ask questions, understand advice and finish with an appropriate request or response.

practice.title: Journey planner
practice.text: Use a timetable and map to choose a route, compare two transport options and explain the journey using times, prepositions and direction language.

practice.title: Distractor detective
practice.text: For each short listening or reading item, underline the evidence, identify the tempting distractor and explain why the correct answer fits the time frame.

practice.title: Travel evidence hunt
practice.text: Scan a travel text for place, time, transport, opinion and problem details, then infer one unstated meaning from context and justify it.

practice.title: Topic A four-skills relay
practice.text: Complete one short listening, reading, speaking and writing station. At every station, retrieve language from a different Topic A subtopic.

b.title: Personal and Social Life
b.summary: Self, family and friends, home, colours, clothes and accessories, leisure time and holidays — developed through description, narration, interaction and opinion.
subtopics: Self, family and friends: identity, appearance, personality and relationships
In the home: rooms, furniture, furnishings, garden and appliances
Colours, clothes and accessories: description, choice, shopping and occasions
Leisure time: activities, hobbies, sport, invitations, holidays and experiences
grammar: Nominal sentences, pronouns and possessive endings
Adjective position and full gender/number agreement
Idāfa, demonstratives, relative pronouns and attached pronouns
Comparative and superlative forms for people, homes and choices
Past tense for leisure experiences and future plans
Connectors, opinions, reasons and balanced personal responses

skills.Listening: Personal profiles, family discussions, invitations, shopping exchanges and leisure interviews
skills.Reading: Profiles, messages, home descriptions, adverts, invitations and holiday accounts
skills.Speaking: Describe people and homes, shop for clothes, respond to invitations and discuss leisure
skills.Writing: Profiles, descriptions, messages, past experiences, plans and extended personal responses

lessons.title: Identity and Personal Profiles
lessons.focus: Introduce and describe yourself accurately in spoken, written and form-based contexts.
lessons.grammar: Pronouns; nominal sentences; gender

lessons.title: Family, Friends and Relationships
lessons.focus: Explain family links, friendship and changing relationships with precise vocabulary.
lessons.grammar: Possessive endings; idāfa; dual and plural

lessons.title: Appearance and Personality
lessons.focus: Build detailed, respectful descriptions and support character judgements with evidence.
lessons.grammar: Adjective agreement; relative pronouns; ليس

lessons.title: My Home, Rooms and Garden
lessons.focus: Describe the layout, location and qualities of a home in connected language.
lessons.grammar: يوجد/توجد; demonstratives; locative prepositions

lessons.title: Furniture, Furnishings and Appliances
lessons.focus: Explain where household items are, what they are used for and what needs changing.
lessons.grammar: Idāfa; attached pronouns; relative clauses

lessons.title: Colours and Accurate Description
lessons.focus: Control regular and irregular colour forms in realistic descriptions.
lessons.grammar: Colour adjective forms; non-human plural agreement

lessons.title: Clothes, Accessories and Shopping
lessons.focus: Choose, compare and buy clothes while discussing size, material, colour and price.
lessons.grammar: Comparatives; numbers; demonstratives; object pronouns

lessons.title: Hobbies, Sport and Free Time
lessons.focus: Discuss regular activities, preferences, ability and the value of leisure.
lessons.grammar: Present tense; verbal nouns; frequency; reasons

lessons.title: Invitations, Holidays and Past Experiences
lessons.focus: Arrange social activities and narrate a memorable leisure or holiday experience.
lessons.grammar: Past tense; future plans; sequencing; polite responses

lessons.title: Topic B Listening and Reading Workshop
lessons.focus: Interpret profiles, messages, descriptions and opinions across all Topic B content.
lessons.grammar: Reference tracking; agreement; contextual deduction

lessons.title: Topic B Speaking and Writing Workshop
lessons.focus: Develop personal answers through detail, reasons, comparisons and time frames.
lessons.grammar: Cohesion; mixed tenses; accuracy editing

lessons.title: Topic B Review and Four-Skills Assessment
lessons.arabic: مُرَاجَعَةُ المِحْوَرِ ب وَتَقْيِيمُ المَهَارَاتِ الأَرْبَعِ
lessons.focus: Demonstrate secure Topic B vocabulary, grammar and independent communication.
lessons.grammar: Cumulative Topic B grammar

practice.title: Identity mystery
practice.text: Create a six-clue personal profile using name, age, place, language, study and personality. A partner identifies the person and checks gender agreement.

practice.title: Family-tree challenge
practice.text: Build a mini family tree from clues, then explain at least four relationships using possessive endings or idāfa without pointing at the answer.

practice.title: Appearance and character match
practice.text: Match physical-description cards to personality clues, then justify which details are facts and which are opinions using accurate adjective agreement.

practice.title: Room detective
practice.text: Describe a room, floor or garden using يوجد/توجد and location phrases. Your partner sketches the layout and checks it against the original.

practice.title: Household redesign
practice.text: Choose furniture and appliances for a room, explain where each item belongs and justify one change using a relative clause or purpose phrase.

practice.title: Colour-agreement snap
practice.text: Match nouns to correct colour forms as quickly as possible. Keep only pairs with correct gender/number agreement and repair any rejected combination.

practice.title: Clothes-shop role-play
practice.text: Ask for an item by size, colour and material, compare alternatives and prices, then decide what to buy and explain the choice.

practice.title: Leisure survey showdown
practice.text: Survey hobbies and sport, rank the most popular activities and report frequency, ability and reasons in connected sentences.

practice.title: Invitation-to-memory timeline
practice.text: Respond to an invitation, describe a past holiday or outing and finish with a future leisure plan using clear time markers and sequencing.

practice.title: Profile evidence hunt
practice.text: Read or listen to short Topic B profiles and messages. Find evidence for identity, relationship, opinion and time frame, then reject one distractor.

practice.title: Speak–upgrade–write
practice.text: Give a 30-second Topic B response, improve it with a comparison and reason, then convert the strongest version into a connected written paragraph.

practice.title: Topic B four-skills relay
practice.text: Rotate through identity, home, clothes and leisure stations. Retrieve vocabulary, grammar and one extended response before checking your weakest area.
